meta.title: Scope Reconciliation Report
meta.subtitle: Acme Loyalty Platform · prepared by BigStep Delivery · sources: SOW v1.0, Dev Plan v2 · evidence: Gmail threads with Acme product team, Apr–Jun 2026.

blocks.text: Everything below is confirmed in scope per SOW v1.0, organised by functional area with the source clause referenced.

items: Loyalty wallet — points accrual, balance, history (SOW §2, Deliverable D1).

blocks.title: Scope-guard — contract lock-ins
body: Fixed-scope Phase 1; changes require a written change order (SOW §Change Control).
Third-party POS integration is explicitly Phase 2 (SOW Exclusions).

items: POS integration — deferred to Phase 2 (SOW Exclusions).
Multi-region data residency — not in Phase 1 (Dev Plan, Future Phases).
Referral engine — raised in feedback, never contracted.

sections.heading: Feedback & Email Evidence Mapped Against Scope

blocks.text: Acme requested a referral-bonus flow. Assessment: Out of Scope — CR Needed. Not in SOW §2 scope nor the Dev Plan; a new workstream requiring estimate + change order.
Wallet shows wrong balance after redemption — 2026-06-03
Reported by Acme QA. Assessment: In Scope — Defect. Wallet accuracy is a D1 acceptance criterion; fix within contracted scope, no CR.

items: Formal CRs raised: none to date.
Informal absorptions: minor copy + theme tweaks accepted into Sprint 4 without CR paperwork.
Timeline: M3 shifted +1 week, client-driven (delayed UAT feedback) — documented in email 2026-06-10.
Process flag: referral request (2026-05-12) discussed but not yet formalised as a CR.
Change-control compliance is weak — one clear CR candidate (referrals) is still informal.
Timeline drift is documented as client-driven, which protects the delivery position.
The wallet-balance issue should be pushed back as a defect, not absorbed as a change.
Commercial exposure is limited so far, but absorbed tweaks should be logged before they compound.
